## Overview

Exact parametric primitive solids and half-spaces, used as CSG leaves. The
values stay exact until someone explicitly tessellates them: constructors do
no tessellation or boolean work, and the finite margin used when a
half-space has to be clipped for meshing is an explicit parameter. It has no
mesh or kernel dependency.

## Depends on

- [`axiolid-core`](./axiolid-core)

## Changes

Latest release, 0.3.1 (2026-09-27):

### Added

- `Primitive::Torus` (#142): a ring torus about local +z, by major and
  minor radius. Horn and spindle tori are not solids and are refused by
  the tessellator.
- `Primitive::Wedge` (#142): OCCT's `MakeWedge` general form with the
  height along local +z -- a base rectangle at z = 0 and a top rectangle,
  narrowed or shifted, at z = height. The top may collapse to a ridge or
  an apex.
